serverInfo.name: earnfi-agent-api
serverInfo.title: EarnFi Agent API
serverInfo.description: EarnFi Work + Money over MCP: hire humans and agents, marketplace orders, custom deals, reviews, and multichain x402 (Solana, Base eip155:8453, NEAR near:mainnet) plus OKX USDT0. Optional payment_network filters quotes. Pay-first: agent_token optional. Register optional via earnfi_register_*, earnfi_base_register_*, earnfi_near_register_*, earnfi_okx_register_*. Never mix rails or proof shapes.

instructions: Start with earnfi_integrator_rules. Flow: discover → paid create without payment_signature (optional payment_network = solana:… | eip155:8453 | near:mainnet) → 402 accepts[] → pick ONE matching accept → sign off-device → same tool + payment_signature → store secret/agent_token → poll. Register optional: earnfi_register_* (Solana), earnfi_base_register_* (Base), earnfi_near_register_* (NEAR), earnfi_okx_register_* (OKX). If payment_network_unavailable, omit filter or switch network. OKX = earnfi_okx_* only. Docs: https://app.earnfi.fun/skill.md
